name: What factors determine the cost of creating a private suite for an adult child?
description: Costs depend on whether you build new square footage or convert existing space, plus the complexity of adding plumbing for a private bathroom or kitchenette.

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of creating a private suite for an adult child?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of adding living space depends on whether you remodel within your home's existing walls or build new construction. Interior remodels, such as converting a family room or garage, generally require fewer structural materials because the exterior building envelope already exists. New ground-up additions require grading, foundation slabs, exterior stuccoing, roof tie-ins, and dedicated utility lines. Adding plumbing for a new walk-in shower or kitchenette will also increase mechanical expenses compared to building a dry bedroom suite. Exact pricing is determined during a tailored project estimate.
